I started a forum for video game discussion. Feedback?

I can understand the appeal of a more traditional forum layout like 4chan to discuss games. Unfortunately, I don't see your site being successful as it doesn't really offer anything new. I don't see a reason to spend my time there rather than on /v/ or v/gaming.

I would suggest working on being different before plugging for users. Fundamentally there needs to be a difference.

Examples: a forum where anti feminists/ feminists discuss games and the politics behind the stories.

A forum where completely obscure and unheard of games are discussed

A forum where indie developers exchange ideas and critique each others WIP games. I particularly like this last idea personally.

That's my honest feedback.

Also gamebants is a terrible name. It sounds like it will be a meme website and not a place for any actual discussion. I would recommend getting a new url. Ive never ran my own site so the difficulty involved is unknown to me, but I think having a better name is essential.

Try not to think of the reward for running a site (money from ads) because that should never be the reason you create something. It should be because you are passionate about something.

I'm just getting started on Youtube and being famous like markiplier or getting rich is not any motivation or incentive for me to do so. I want to make videos that I would enjoy watching, to share experiences with others. If it was for fame or money I would find myself copying. Like Banksy once said, "good artists copy, great artists steal". You take the soul, the passion and make it your own. This is why I think you need an original idea or something to motivate and invite users.
